articles.title: Hong Kong Upgrades Heat Alerts to Better Protect Outdoor Workers
articles.summary: Hong Kong's Labour Department is updating its heat stress warning system to give workers more protection during extremely hot weather. Under the new plan, alerts will be sent out sooner and will carry stronger warnings than before. This change comes after concerns that outdoor workers, such as construction and delivery workers, face serious health risks during Hong Kong's hot and humid summers. The updated system is designed to tell workers and employers earlier when conditions are dangerously warm, so they can take breaks and stay safe. Experts say climate change is making summers longer and hotter, which means better heat protection rules are becoming more important every year.

lv1: What government department in Hong Kong is changing the heat warning system? (香港哪個政府部門正在改變酷熱警告系統？)
Name one type of outdoor worker who could benefit from the new heat alerts. (說出一種可以受惠於新酷熱警報的戶外工人。)
lv2: Why is it important to send heat stress warnings earlier rather than later? (為什麼提早發出酷熱警告比遲發出更重要？)
How might climate change make heat stress warnings even more necessary in the future? (氣候變化如何令酷熱警報在未來變得更加必要？)
lv3: Should the government make it a legal requirement for employers to give workers paid rest breaks during high heat alerts? Why or why not? (政府是否應該立法規定僱主在高度酷熱警報期間給予工人有薪休息時間？為什麼？)

Some argue that economic productivity is harmed when outdoor work stops due to heat alerts. How should society balance worker safety against economic concerns? (有人認為，因酷熱警報而停止戶外工作會損害經濟生產力。社會應如何平衡工人安全與經濟考量？)

articles.title: Asia's Himalayan Water Supply Is Disappearing Faster Than Expected
articles.summary: Scientists have found that the region known as Asia's 'Water Tower' — the high mountains and glaciers of the Tibetan Plateau — is losing about 24.2 billion tonnes of groundwater every year. This underground water feeds rivers and farmland across much of Asia, supporting the lives of hundreds of millions of people. Researchers warn that while melting glaciers might add some water to rivers temporarily around the 2060s, the overall situation will get much worse unless people use water more carefully. Heavily farmed areas are seeing the sharpest drops in water levels. Scientists say urgent action is needed to change how water is managed across the whole region before the shortage becomes a crisis.

lv1: How many billion tonnes of groundwater does Asia's 'Water Tower' region lose each year? (亞洲「水塔」地區每年流失多少億噸地下水？)
What are glaciers, and why are they important for rivers? (冰川是什麼？它們為什麼對河流很重要？)
lv2: Why might farming regions be losing groundwater faster than other areas? (為什麼農業地區流失地下水的速度可能比其他地區更快？)
Scientists say glacier melt could temporarily help water supply around the 2060s. Why is this only a short-term solution? (科學家說，冰川融化可能在2060年代暫時補充水源。為什麼這只是短期解決方案？)
lv3: If multiple countries share the same water source from the Tibetan Plateau, who should be responsible for managing and protecting it? (如果多個國家共享來自青藏高原的同一水源，誰應該負責管理和保護它？)
Is it fair that countries which use the most water for farming face the greatest shortages? What changes in food production or lifestyle could help? (使用最多農業用水的國家面臨最大水源短缺，這公平嗎？哪些農業生產或生活方式的改變可以幫助解決問題？)

articles.title: 香港擬立法規管網約車　最快年底開始發牌
articles.summary: 香港政府計劃為網約車服務制定法律規管，預計最快今年第四季開放網約車牌照及司機牌照申請，並於11月起向網約車平台正式發牌。運輸及物流局表示，現階段政府未有就車費設定上下限。網約車服務近年在香港愈來愈普及，不少市民選擇以手機程式叫車出行。政府希望透過發牌制度，確保乘客安全及服務質素，同時令傳統的士與新式網約車之間的競爭更加公平。

lv1: 政府計劃在哪個季度開放網約車牌照申請？
網約車是什麼？市民通常如何使用這種服務？
lv2: 為什麼政府要為網約車服務制定法律規管？
如果政府規定網約車收費設有上下限，對乘客和司機各有什麼影響？
lv3: 網約車合法化會否令傳統的士業面臨不公平競爭？政府應如何平衡兩者的利益？
發牌制度能否真正保障乘客安全？除了發牌，還有哪些方法可以提升網約車服務的安全性？

articles.title: 新田科技城面積達210公頃　盼吸引芯片及無人機企業進駐
articles.summary: 新田科技城主席查毅超表示，位於香港新界的新田科技城總面積達210公頃，是香港發展創新科技的重要基地。科技城希望吸引芯片製造、無人機及其他高新科技企業入駐，推動香港發展成為國際創科中心。新田科技城毗鄰深圳，地理位置優越，有助香港融入大灣區的科技發展。政府希望藉此創造更多高質素就業機會，並吸引更多科技人才留港發展，令香港在全球科技競爭中保持優勢。

lv1: 新田科技城的總面積是多少公頃？
新田科技城希望吸引哪兩類高新科技企業進駐？
lv2: 新田科技城的地理位置有什麼優勢？這對香港的科技發展有什麼幫助？
為什麼政府希望吸引科技企業到新田科技城，而不是在市區發展？
lv3: 香港發展科技城能否真正令香港成為國際創科中心？與深圳、新加坡等競爭對手相比，香港有哪些優勢和劣勢？
科技城的發展可能會對周邊環境和居民造成什麼影響？我們應如何在科技發展與保護環境之間取得平衡？
